gaps: Every listed partition is unobserved; no literal expected values, repeatability claims, or portable features are created here.
Source-level parser productions and printf directive inventory are intentionally owned by docs/research/api and must be linked before probes.
DM5/DM6 compatibility differences need separate fresh-process observations; DM5 is a compatibility profile, not a fallback for DM6 results.
A normalized outcome protocol must distinguish absent input, empty text, no match, numeric status, empty facade return, warning/diagnostic, and receiver error state.
Configuration keys need a per-key defaults and validation matrix; cross-family keys remain for their assigned catalogues plus integration cases.
